## Welcome to the short course!

This page contains slides and code examples for the short course on Highly Adaptive Lasso and Targeted Learning at the DahShu Data Science Symposium 2025.

## Environment setup

-   R (≥ 4.3) installed.
-   Recommended IDE: RStudio.
-   R packages required:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
install.packages("hal9001")
install.packages("haldensify")
remotes::install_github("tlverse/sl3")
remotes::install_github("tq21/atmle")
```

## Relevant books/papers for this short course

-   van der Laan, Mark and Sherri Rose (2011) Targeted Learning: Causal Inference for Observational and Experimental Data. Springer Science & Business Media. [\[Link\]](https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-1-4419-9782-1)

-   van der Laan, Mark and Sherri Rose (2018) Targeted Learning in Data Science: Causal Inference for Complex Longitudinal Studies. Springer Science & Business Media. [\[Link\]](https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-319-65304-4)

-   van der Laan, Mark. “A generally efficient targeted minimum loss based estimator based on the highly adaptive lasso.” The international journal of biostatistics 13.2 (2017). [\[Link\]](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/document/doi/10.1515/ijb-2015-0097/html)

-   Benkeser, David, and Mark van der Laan. “The highly adaptive lasso estimator.” 2016 IEEE international conference on data science and advanced analytics (DSAA). IEEE, 2016. [\[Link\]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5662030/)

-   van der Laan, Mark. “Higher order spline highly adaptive lasso estimators of functional parameters: Pointwise asymptotic normality and uniform convergence rates.” arXiv preprint arXiv:2301.13354 (2023). [\[Link\]](https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.13354)

-   van der Laan, Lars, Marco Carone, Alex Luedtke, and Mark van der Laan. “Adaptive debiased machine learning using data-driven model selection techniques.” arXiv preprint arXiv:2307.12544 (2023). [\[Link\]](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.12544)

-   van der Laan, Mark, Sky Qiu, Jens Tarp, and Lars van der Laan. “Adaptive-TMLE for the average treatment effect based on randomized controlled trial augmented with real-world data.” arXiv preprint arXiv:2405.07186 (2024). [\[Link\]](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.07186)

-   Qiu, Sky, Jens Tarp, Andrew Mertens, and Mark van der Laan. “An estimator-robust design for augmenting randomized controlled trial with external real-world data.” arXiv preprint arXiv:2501.17835 (2025). [\[Link\]](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.17835)

-   Shirakawa, Toru, Yi Li, Yulun Wu, Sky Qiu, Yuxuan Li, Mingduo Zhao, Hiroyasu Iso, and Mark van der Laan. “Longitudinal targeted minimum loss-based estimation with temporal-difference heterogeneous transformer.” Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 235:45097-45113 (2024). [\[Link\]](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.04399)
